summary: Frontend e2e verified all 4 phases + regression for VoPP clinic app. Phase 1 (Progress Notes stacked header + PDF layout), Phase 2 (Patients SSN persistence + Privacy click-to-reveal masking), Phase 3 (Billing Reports filters + revenue chart + inline status + bulk delete + CSV), Phase 4 (ICD/CPT memory chips) all functional. Regression: Unpaid card deep-link, bilingual toggle, bulk delete without confirm all working.
critical_code_review_comments: PrivacyContext uses useState (in-memory only) - state resets on full page reload. Acceptable for MVP but consider sessionStorage for durability across F5.
Notes.js line ~199 uses useState with no error boundary; a failure in patient-code-history endpoint is silently swallowed which is intentional per code but hides regressions.
Provider dropdown (nf-provider) shows empty when no doctor/nurse/psychologist users exist in DB. Consider showing all users or a fallback.
